Found during Handout 2.5, NOT fixed: jnwb.decoding.decode_stimulus_identity (the presented-identity positive control) also uses StratifiedKFold(shuffle=True), the same ungrouped-CV pattern as the quarantined omitted-identity scripts. Lower stakes than the omitted-identity case since the positive control's whole point is that a strong real signal should dominate any cycle-nuisance confound either way, but noted for completeness and symmetry with the P0 finding this whole repair pass addressed.

The Skill tool does not re-read a skill file from disk on a second invocation within the SAME session -- it reported 'already loaded above; instructions unchanged' after this pass edited the file. This means an agent's own in-session re-invocation cannot be trusted as proof a skill edit took effect; a genuinely fresh session (this pass used a subagent) is required. This is a real property of the runtime worth remembering for any future skill-patch-then-verify workflow.
